topic: Renting a venue for a kids birthday party on credit vs a backyard party with a cap (Graham vs Esme)

scenes.narration: The average kids party now costs more than a month of groceries. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a birthday cake beside a receipt as tall as him, comic burst banner reads MORE THAN GROCERIES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Graham and Esme both have a kid turning seven next month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man graham and woman esme each with a smiling child holding a number seven balloon, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Graham books a trampoline venue for twenty five kids.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man graham at a trampoline park counter signing a booking form reading TWENTY FIVE KIDS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Venue, pizza, a character actor, and goodie bags total nine hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt listing VENUE, PIZZA, CHARACTER, GOODIE BAGS with a total reading NINE HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He puts it on a card and pays it off over five months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man graham swiping a credit card, a statement shows five monthly payments with interest, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The kid remembers the cake. Nobody remembers the venue.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a child happily eating cake, the fancy venue blurry and forgotten in the background, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Esme sets a one hundred fifty dollar cap and hosts in the backyard.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman esme writing ONE FIFTY CAP on a notepad, a backyard with a picnic table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten friends, a homemade cake, a water balloon war, and pizza.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, kids in a backyard water balloon fight, a homemade cake on a table, pizza boxes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Total spent, one hundred thirty dollars. Debt, zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt reading ONE HUNDRED THIRTY, a tag reads ZERO DEBT, confetti, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The kid calls it the best party ever, twice.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a child with a huge grin and a speech bubble reading BEST PARTY EVER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Graham paid nine hundred plus interest. Esme paid one thirty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man graham beside a credit statement, woman esme beside a small receipt, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kids remember fun, not price tags. Cap the party. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading CAP THE PARTY, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
